name: Stage 35: Holmtorp to Nävsjön
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 35, Holmtorp to Nävsjön.
utilities: Official area: Norrköpings kommun, Nyköpings kommun.

No parking at Holmtorp; official guidance says to park about 1.5 km earlier on stage 34 near Vrångsjö. Nävsjön has hiker/reserve/fishery parking, dry toilet context, pump, fishing permit machine, and several shelters/rest points, but fishing-association parking inside the fishery area requires a valid fishing permit.

Public transport is weak at both ends: Västanåvägen is about 2.5-2.9 km from Holmtorp, Nävsjövägen bus stop on line 561 is several km from Nävsjön by road/trail, and the useful train anchors are distant Kolmården or Nyköping C with bus/taxi/bike/pickup logistics.
waterSources: Official water: Svartsjön spring after about 7-7.5 km and Nävsjön pump near the stage end. Treat/filter/boil and verify all water; Sörmlandsleden says trail water is not routinely checked or guaranteed.

A 2024-11-23 public comment on the official stage page reported dead frogs in the Svartsjön spring and advised bringing water, so treat that source as unreliable until rechecked on site and carry backup water.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official distance is 12 km and the local official-GPX route geometry measures about 11.9 km, so the drawn route is plausible. Naturkartan shows 12.0 km / 12,171 m, OSM relation 3696285 measures about 12.06 km, and Naturkartan public geometry about 12.14 km; avoid implying exact metre-level distance.
Stage 35 crosses county/reserve contexts: Naturkartan lists the stage under Östergötland, while Nävsjön reserve rules are from Södermanland and nearby Nävsjömossen rules from Östergötland.
Near Holmtorp, grazing cattle may occur in pasture; keep dogs controlled and handle gates/fences carefully.

When the trail leaves the road early in the stage, an official 200 m side path reaches Vrångsjön's eastern shore with swimming and a possible tent spot on rock. Verify signs and boundaries before tenting, and do not generalize this to protected Nävsjön reserve areas.

The route passes mixed forest and agricultural land, modern forestry/clear-cut areas, then improves around Svartsjön and Nävsjön with lake, mire, boardwalk, older-pine, and shelter/rest character. Despite Naturkartan's green/simple label, user reports describe wet vegetation, rutted/flooded tracks, young birch hiding the tread, overgrown cultural land, roots, slippery boardwalks and tick-season concerns after rain.

No official stage-35 fault reports were shown on the Sörmlandsleden page during the 2026-04-27 research pass, but the page comments include the 2024 Svartsjön spring warning. Treat no formal fault report as a status snapshot, not a guarantee.

Nävsjön reserve rules are strict: no tenting, no fires, dogs leashed, no damaging living/dead wood, and no plant picking except berries/mushrooms. In nearby Nävsjömossen, keep dogs leashed, protect plants/wildlife, and use only arranged grill places where allowed.

Nävsjön shelters are not all equivalent: the west/north shelter is primarily for fishers, the south-bay shelter is mainly Nävsjön-runt context, and map-source condition/capacity notes should be treated as current-condition caveats rather than guarantees.

Fishing at Nävsjön requires a permit and local fishery rules apply, including one hand tackle with max one hook/lure, max three salmonids per permit, no live/dead bait fish and no sonar/electronic fishing equipment. Fishing prices and boat/cabin details can change, so link users to Nävsjön Sportfiske rather than hard-coding a trip budget.

At Nävsjön, Stage 35, Stage 36, Stage 36:1 and Nävsjön runt all meet or share physical ways. Use the complete Nävsjön runt loop relation for loop display, not the partial duplicate arc, and avoid drawing duplicate lines over the shared Stage 35/36 sections.

facilities.name: Holmtorp stage start
facilities.description: Official start of stage 35 and junction with stage 34. No parking directly at Holmtorp; park near Vrångsjö on stage 34 or arrange pickup.

facilities.name: Västanåvägen bus access
facilities.description: Nearest researched Holmtorp-side bus access, roughly 2.9 km from the start and therefore off-route planning context; verify service before relying on it.

facilities.name: Kolmården station
facilities.description: Nearest researched train station to the Holmtorp side, but about 13 km away; needs bus, taxi, bike, or pickup logistics.

facilities.name: Vrångsjön/Fjällmossen parking approach
facilities.description: Main Fjällmossen entrance northwest of Vrångsjön with about 10 car spaces plus bus space, grill, wood storage and picnic table. Practical parking before Holmtorp, but it adds approach distance.

facilities.name: Vrångsjön east shore swim/tent rock
facilities.description: Official text describes a 200 m side path to Vrångsjön's eastern shore with bathing and possible tenting on rock. Approximate pin; verify reserve boundary/signs before camping and do not use as a Nävsjön-reserve camping rule.

facilities.name: Holmtorp pasture/cattle warning
facilities.description: Grazing cattle may occur in pasture near Holmtorp; keep dogs controlled and close gates.

facilities.name: Svartsjön spring
facilities.description: Official natural spring after about 7-7.5 km, but a 2024-11-23 official-page comment reported dead frogs. Treat/filter, inspect carefully, and carry backup water.

facilities.name: Svartsjön shelter
facilities.description: Official shelter/rest point on Svartsjön's northeast side, built in 2006 and consistently praised as a good rest/overnight spot.

facilities.name: Svartsjön dry toilet
facilities.description: Dry/pit toilet at/near the Svartsjön shelter area; map-source coordinate, verify on site.

facilities.name: Nävsjön pump
facilities.description: Official pump near the stage end; verify function/season locally and do not assume routine water testing.

facilities.name: Nävsjön hiker/reserve/fishery parking
facilities.description: Large fishery parking and fishing-card machine at the north end. Fishing-association parking inside its area requires a valid fishing permit; other visitors should use the free passenger-car parking in the slope outside the large parking and follow local signs.

facilities.name: Nävsjön dry toilet
facilities.description: Dry toilet/service context on the Nävsjön/Nävsjömossen side; useful for the endpoint/loop area but not directly beside every shelter.

facilities.name: Nävsjön fishing permit machine
facilities.description: Fishing permits for stocked fish are sold at/near the north parking area by machine/Swish. Permit required; local rules include one hand tackle, max one hook/lure, max three salmonids per permit, no bait fish and no sonar/electronic fishing equipment.

facilities.name: Nävsjön Sportfiske cabin/boat context
facilities.description: Fishery context near the north parking: boats and a simple cabin may be available through Nävsjön Sportfiske. Book/check current rules before relying on it; this is not a general trail shelter.

facilities.name: Nävsjön swimming/fishing
facilities.description: Small-bay swimming and stocked fishing context at Nävsjön; not a formal beach. Fishing permit required and reserve rules restrict tenting/fires.

facilities.name: Nävsjön west/fishery shelter
facilities.description: Official shelter on the west/north side of Nävsjön, primarily for fishers; hikers may use it if space is available. Community map notes for nearby fishery shelters report small capacities and condition gaps, so verify before relying on it.

facilities.name: Nävsjön south bay shelter / Nävsjön runt
facilities.description: Official shelter in Nävsjön's south bay, about 0.9 km from the stage-35 line and mainly useful for Nävsjön runt/loop context rather than a direct Stage 35 finish.

facilities.name: Nävsjön kolarkoja context
facilities.description: Overnight hut near the stage-36/Nävsjömossen side. Official sources mention it as an option just into stage 36, but OSM/community notes report fire damage/charred condition; verify before relying on it.

facilities.name: Nävsjömossen southwest entrance
facilities.description: Reserve entrance/parking at the southwest end with about 10 spaces, information, grill place, woodshed and roofed table. Useful for Nävsjömossen/Nävsjön loop access, but off the direct Stage 35 line.

facilities.name: Nävsjömossen toilet context
facilities.description: Nearby Nävsjön/Nävsjömossen loop toilet context, about 0.9 km from the direct stage-35 line and useful if continuing around the lake.

facilities.name: Nävsjön stage end
facilities.description: Stage 35 end and junction with stage 36 and branch 36:1. Show Nävsjön runt and onward stages as options when this endpoint is selected.

facilities.name: Nävsjövägen bus access
facilities.description: Bus 561 access toward Nyköping/Nävekvarn, several km from Nävsjön by road; mark as off-route access and verify timetable.

facilities.name: Nyköping C train access
facilities.description: Practical train anchor for the Nävsjön/Nävekvarn side, but about 18 km from Nävsjön; combine with bus 561, taxi, bike, or pickup.

facilities.name: Nävsjön reserve rules
facilities.description: Nävsjön reserve: no tenting, no fires, dogs leashed, no motor vehicles, no damaging living/dead wood, and no plant picking except berries/mushrooms. Do not present Nävsjön generally as a camping/fire area.

facilities.name: Nävsjömossen reserve rules
facilities.description: Nävsjömossen context: keep dogs leashed, protect plants/wildlife, boardwalks can be slippery when damp, and use only arranged grill places where allowed; do not build new fire rings.
